I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread: "Thanks, Pree. Updated: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23 as noted earlier." Gate 47 now replaces Dock 23 as the site on record.

She said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. My earlier "Dock 23" reply is still in its thread, so anyone reading only that one will see the old site.
